space.description: Regularized xp Hamiltonian intended to reproduce Riemann-zero spectral asymptotics.

dynamics.primitive_objects: periodic-orbit structure incomplete in bare model

operator.formula: (xp + px)/2 in a basic symmetric quantization; domain/boundary choices matter

trace_formula.notes: Strong on the smooth counting term; bare xp does not supply the full prime orbit structure.

claims.claim: Regularized xp reproduces the smooth counting asymptotics semiclassically.

name: Deninger arithmetic dynamical systems
references: Christopher Deninger, Dynamical systems for arithmetic schemes, arXiv:1807.06400

space.description: Infinite-dimensional real dynamical systems attached to arithmetic schemes.
space.arithmetic_input: normal schemes finite type over Spec(Z)

dynamics.primitive_objects: periodic orbits related to closed points
dynamics.primitive_length_rule: arithmetic closed-point norms suggest logarithmic lengths

trace_formula.notes: Geometric dictionary is compelling; full RH-producing trace/positivity mechanism is incomplete.

symmetries.functional_equation_mechanism: cohomological duality expected in the program

claims.claim: Constructs infinite-dimensional R-dynamical systems whose periodic orbits are related to closed points.

space.description: Noncommutative geometric space associated with adèle classes.
space.arithmetic_input: adèles and idèles of a global field

dynamics.primitive_objects: periodic orbits associated with finite places
dynamics.primitive_length_rule: log p in the Q case
dynamics.repetition_rule: iterates produce multiples of log p

operator.spectrum_type: critical zeros as absorption spectrum; noncritical zeros would appear as resonances in the 1998 formulation

trace_formula.notes: Explicit formulas are interpreted as a trace formula; RH is tied to completing the trace/positivity picture.

claims.claim: Gives a spectral interpretation of critical zeros and a trace-formula interpretation of explicit formulas.

name: Selberg trace-formula template
references: Classical Selberg trace formula / Selberg zeta theory

space.description: A control model: geometric spectrum paired with primitive closed geodesics.

trace_formula.notes: Excellent structural template, but not itself the Riemann zeta trace formula.

symmetries.functional_equation_mechanism: Selberg-zeta functional equation in appropriate settings

claims.claim: Provides an exact spectral/closed-geodesic trace formula.
